name: workflow_create
description: Instantiate a new workflow run from a stored workflow definition. Loads the workflow JSON by id, validates it, captures the caller-provided input, and returns a runId plus the initial cursor (the first step to execute). The orchestrator session must call this exactly once at the start of a run before any other workflow_* tool. Workflow definitions live in .opendora/workflows/<id>.json. This tool does not execute any step — it only prepares the run.

workflowId.description: Identifier of the workflow definition to load.

input.description: Initial input passed to the workflow. Must satisfy the workflow's declared input schema. Becomes available as $input.* throughout the run.

title.description: Optional human-readable title for this run; surfaced in UI and logs.
